This internship is for you! Who are we? Mitsubishi HC Capital Canada and its parent company, Mitsubishi HC Capital America, form the largest non-captive, non-bank commercial finance company in North America. By joining our team, you'll thrive in an environment where collaboration and mutual support are more than just words. Here, you'll have the space to learn quickly, take on responsibilities, and grow your career through hands-on guidance and internal opportunities. About the Internship This internship will immerse you in the world of test automation and software quality assurance during the implementation of new features. You will actively contribute to the development and improvement of the technological tools used by our teams. Under the guidance of the Quality Assurance Manager, you will have the opportunity to work with a mentor during code reviews, daily stands-up, and 1:1 sessions. You'll work within an approachable, passionate team ready to support you at every step of your learning journey. You'll be exposed to modern methodologies (CI/CD, automation, API testing) while having a direct impact on the quality of our internal solutions. Your Project Will Include: • Designing an automated test suite integrated into the current CI/CD pipeline. • Documenting test cases, automation steps, and pipeline configuration. • Producing a report illustrating progress and automation coverage of the test suite. • Maintaining up-to-date test scripts. • Contributing to improving test coverage and reducing manual testing. And most importantly: learning every day and making a real impact! • What You'll Develop: • The ability to identify test cases and map existing scripts that cover them. • Skills to detect anomalies and learn how to diagnose and improve tests and automation steps accordingly. • A solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and the importance of automation in software development. Hands-on experience in a professional setting. • Ready to take on the challenge? Apply now and join a team that invests in your potential! • Location: Burlington or Trois-Rivières - Hybrid Mode • Duration: 3 months • Workweek: 37.5 hours (Monday to Friday) Status: New position • We would like to thank all applicants in advance. Should you be selected for an interview, you will be contacted directly. Mitsubishi HC Capital Canada values diversity and is committed to accessibility. Should you require accommodation due to disability, please notify the Human Resources Recruiter. Job Requirements Profile we are looking for: • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering. • University-accredited internship • Proficiency in French and English (oral and written), an asset. • Knowledge of JavaScript, good understanding of CI/CD concepts, API. • Ability to work with a user-focused and problem-solving approach. • Analytical mindset, attention to detail, curiosity, and team spirit. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. • Citizenship Requirement N/A APPLICATION INFORMATION Application Procedure Through Employer Website Special Application Instructions Application Link: Career Centre | Recruitment Please click the "I intend to apply to this position" button on SCOPE and also submit your application via the employer's website.
